content.title: About
content.content: Pancake Syrup Light is a gently sweetened, low‑sugar syrup designed for drizzling over pancakes, waffles and crepes. It has a subtle vanilla‑caramel aroma that enhances the dish without overpowering the batter, making it suitable for diet‑conscious eating.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The Light version contains roughly 2‑3 times less sugar than regular pancake syrup.
It is sweetened with natural low‑calorie sweeteners such as stevia or erythritol, making it friendly for blood‑sugar management.
No artificial colors or flavors are used.
The syrup dissolves smoothly in both hot and cold preparations, without crystallizing.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: Low Sugar Content
items.content: Helps prevent rapid spikes in blood glucose, beneficial for people with pre‑diabetes or diabetes.

items.title: Natural Sweeteners
items.content: Stevia and erythritol provide antioxidant benefits and do not affect blood sugar levels.

items.title: Free of Artificial Additives
items.content: Absence of synthetic colors and flavors reduces liver and digestive system load.

items.title: Supports Hydration
items.content: Contains a small amount of electrolytes that aid in maintaining fluid balance.

items.title: Convenient Use
items.content: Its thin consistency allows quick, even distribution over dishes without extra effort.

items.title: Allergy to Sweeteners
items.content: Some individuals may react to stevia or erythritol.

items.title: Artificial Flavor Trace
items.content: In rare cases, minimal amounts of flavorings may be present, which could cause sensitivity.

items.title: Caloric Content
items.content: Although lighter than regular syrup, it should still be consumed in moderation.

items.title: Post‑Opening Storage
items.content: Extended storage after opening can lead to microbial growth; use within 3‑4 weeks.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drizzle the syrup over hot pancakes, waffles or crepes just before serving. It can also be mixed into batter for a gentle sweetness, used as a base for fruit sauces, or blended with yogurt.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the syrup in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, refrigerate and use within 1 month. Discard if the smell or taste changes.
